title: Fabula Ultima Combat Simulator
description: Test encounters before running them in Project FU: hundreds of simulated battles with the Fabula Ultima rules (initiative, alternating turns, elites and champions, checks, crits and fumbles, affinities, Guard, Remedies and Elixirs) and a smart tactical AI for heroes and monsters, with win rate, difficulty, KO rates, damage shares, notes and a sample battle log.
